set(DISCORD_SDK_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
set(DISCORD_SDK_LIB_DIR "${DISCORD_SDK_ROOT}/lib")
set(DISCORD_SDK_BIN_DIR "${DISCORD_SDK_ROOT}/bin")
set(DISCORD_SDK_INCLUDE_DIR "${DISCORD_SDK_ROOT}/include" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DISCORD_SDK_VERSION "1.10.19337")

if(WIN32)
    set(DISCORD_LIB_PATH "${DISCORD_SDK_LIB_DIR}/discord_partner_sdk.lib" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(DISCORD_SHARED_LIB "${DISCORD_SDK_BIN_DIR}/discord_partner_sdk.dll" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
elseif(APPLE)
    set(DISCORD_LIB_PATH "${DISCORD_SDK_LIB_DIR}/libdiscord_partner_sdk.dylib" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(DISCORD_SHARED_LIB "${DISCORD_SDK_LIB_DIR}/libdiscord_partner_sdk.dylib" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
else() # Linux
    set(DISCORD_LIB_PATH "${DISCORD_SDK_LIB_DIR}/libdiscord_partner_sdk.so" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(DISCORD_SHARED_LIB "${DISCORD_SDK_LIB_DIR}/libdiscord_partner_sdk.so" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endif()

if(UNIX)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH TRUE)
    set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN")
    if(APPLE)
        set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "@executable_path")
    endif()
endif()

message(STATUS "DiscordSocialSDK: Version ${DISCORD_SDK_VERSION}")
